changes: Fix: Save As, Open, Import and Export no longer leave the window "Not responding" while you choose a file.

A fit-function library of its own, 30 functions by category: exponential decay, growth and rise (ExpDec1, ExpGro1, ExpAssoc…), logarithm, peaks, sigmoids, power laws, and soil water retention (van Genuchten, Brooks-Corey) and hyperbolic stress-strain. Each starts from values guessed from the data.
Save to my functions: keep a formula you typed in the Nonlinear Fit dialog for every project.
The Nonlinear Fit dialog groups functions by category and shows the formula of the one you pick.
For AI assistants (MCP): fitfunc_list gives category, source and formula; fitfunc_save keeps a formula in your library.
